test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_automaton_bench ( id UInt64, body String, INDEX idx body TYPE text(tokenizer = array, dictionary_block_size = 128) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_automaton_bench SELECT number, concat(if(number % 1000 = 0, 'service', 'unrelated'), toString(number), 'error') FROM numbers(1000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_automaton_bench WHERE body LIKE 'service%error'
